'''Giant grackles''' are [[giant animal]] counterparts of regular [[grackle]]s, who spawn in any [[savage]] [[temperate]] [[savanna]]s and [[shrubland]]s. Unlike their basal equivalents, giant cockatiels are larger than a [[grizzly bear]]. They appear in clusters of 5-10 individuals, and are not benign so may defend themselves if provoked.


[[File:giant_grackle_preview.jpg|thumb|340px|center|In its point of view, dwarves and elves are berries and worms.<br><small>''Art by Carly Weaver''</small>]]

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] giant cockatiels for their ''raucous calls''.
